answer_1.quote: we prompt the models with the following template: Paraphrase this text: "{text}" Paraphrased text:
answer_1.outputs: paraphrased versions of hate speech and non-hateful social media posts

answer_2.quote: The metrics we use for evaluating classifiers are macro-F 1 and minority class (hate) F 1.

answer_4.quote: The qualitative analysis was carried out by two annotators, one male and one female, both with expertise in online language use, hate speech, and LLM-generated text.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are provided with a sample of 500 texts (both gold and synthetic) and asked whether each example appears to be written by a human or an LLM... Annotators are provided with an additional sample of 3,000 synthetic-only examples... annotated along a variety of axes, including grammaticality, presence of hate speech, and presence of identity mentions.
